100.$description: $gray-100 #F3F3F3, also $light. The grays of theme 5 are neutral, where the design system's lean blue: every semantic token built on them follows.

900.$description: $gray-900 #1A1A1A, the body colour and the surface of the cards.

heading.$description: Headings take the body colour, as in Bootstrap, where the design system sets them in black.

default.$description: $light $gray-100, one step lighter than the design system's: the light themes and the buttons over a darkened cover.

offset.$description: $shadow-color #E6E6E6: the flat shadow offset to the bottom left of the cards and of the items of the comparison, informations and testimonials blocks, a step darker than the card it sits under (gray-200 under gray-100). A themed block or hero composes it again from its own card, see theme/base/shadow.css.

offsetStep.$description: How much darker than the card the offset shadow is, in oklch lightness: the step from gray-100 to gray-200.
